params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: the same high-school classroom seen from beside the teacher's lectern at the front, looking toward the back: the rows of single desks with students in black blazers, a tall athletic boy with slicked-back hair in the front row by the window turning to grin and raise a thumb, a heavy-set boy smirking in the second row; the back wall with grey steel cubby lockers, the cork bulletin board with blank colored papers, the rear sliding door open with the corridor light; the tall left windows with the fortress wall and pines outside; dust motes in the morning sun shafts across the desks. The player character stands at the back door in a black school blazer, small in the distance. Bright morning light with soft cool shadows. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
